race.comment: LYRICS 'N' SONG (13) resumes. She's the daughter of star galloper Melody Belle who only had the one run last time in at Cranbourne, beaten under a length in a high rating affair. 1300m is a good spot for her and her mother certainly didn't mind a heavy track. YUKI (11) is a promising gelding who won well on debut in a good form race before just missing a nose at Geelong. Better again and will take beating with even luck. SAVOYARD (4) resumes having won well on debut before an excellent second in the Future Stars Final. That's good form but not sure how far back he gets from the carpark. CELESTIAL ZARA (12) won well enough fresh and should strip fitter, each way along with ELECTRIC ELVIS (6) who is racing well and gets every chance again.
